newsitem.title: USA: Hancock Fabrics okays one mln shr buyback.
newsitem.headline: Hancock Fabrics okays one mln shr buyback.

text.p: Hancock Fabrics Inc said on Tuesday its board of directors authorized the repurchase of up to one million shares of the company's stock, depending on fiancial and market conditions.

Chief Executive Officer Larry Kirk said the authorization was part of an ongoing share repurchase program dating back to 1989. "Since that time, the company has repurchased almost six million shares or over 21 percent of the total shares outstanding," he said.
The company said it was confident its financial capacity would accomodate continued share repurchases as well as national expansion, new concept development and acquisition opportunities.
Shares would be repurchased in the open market, it said.
